en.summary: Glaucoma can damage the optic nerve, often without early symptoms. Acute angle-closure glaucoma is an emergency: sudden severe eye pain, headache, nausea, halos, red eye and blurred vision — seek emergency care immediately. Routine open-angle disease needs optometrist/ophthalmology pathways. Never invent eye-drop doses.
emergencyIf: Sudden severe eye pain with nausea/vomiting
Sudden vision loss or coloured halos with red eye
seeDoctorIf: Family history / risk factors — regular eye checks
doNot: Do not invent glaucoma drop regimens
Do not delay acute painful red eye with vision change

fr.summary: Glaucome: urgence si douleur oculaire brutale, nausées, halos, œil rouge. Pas de posologies inventées.

he.summary: גלאוקומה: חירום בכאב עין פתאומי, בחילות, הילות, עין אדומה. אין טיפות מומצאות.

ru.summary: Глаукома: неотложка при внезапной боли в глазу, тошноте, радужных кругах. Капли не выдумывать.
emergencyIf: Внезапная сильная боль в глазу с тошнотой
